description: View customer-level AI and custom-meter usage recorded in your UsageTap account. Review recent calls and costs, compare models and providers, check plan allowances, balances, and replenishment dates, and identify unusual usage or customers nearing their limits. The plugin is read-only and cannot change plans, contact customers, or modify account data.

defaultPrompt: Which customers need attention because of low remaining allowance or unusual recent usage?
Show me our active customers and their current account status.
Summarize our AI usage over the last seven days and rank the models by recorded cost.
